remarks: Welcome to your perfect new home! This beautifully maintained, move-in ready cooperative offers effortless living just a short stroll from vibrant Downtown Stamford. Nestled among lush, professionally landscaped gardens, this light-filled unit offers the perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and charm. Ideal for first-time homebuyers or those looking to downsize, this first-floor residence features spacious, sun-drenched living areas, in-unit laundry, and ample storage-including a dedicated storage unit. Enjoy the ease of assigned parking, with the option for a second space for just $25/month. Step outside and enjoy the serene grounds, or take advantage of the unbeatable location close to shops, dining, entertainment, and public transportation.
